background_unlocks.what: issuer unlock calls in the background (latency includes the CLI's process start)

key_to_first_byte_quiet.conditions: one TUI on a 120x40 pty, view keys 2 and 1 in turn; no background work (for comparison)

key_to_first_byte_slow_store.conditions: one TUI on a 120x40 pty, view keys 2 and 1 in turn, while `issuer unlock` runs in a loop: each makes the runtime's issuer child load its CA from the Secret Service through a bus relay holding each request 500 ms. Measures issuer secret-store load under a slow Secret Service, not each signature

key_to_frame_quiet.conditions: one TUI on a 120x40 pty, view keys 2 and 1 in turn; no background work (for comparison); timed only once the reconstructed screen shows the selected view's title, absent before the key; the frame ends at the last byte before 20 ms of quiet

key_to_frame_slow_store.conditions: one TUI on a 120x40 pty, view keys 2 and 1 in turn, while `issuer unlock` runs in a loop: each makes the runtime's issuer child load its CA from the Secret Service through a bus relay holding each request 500 ms. Measures issuer secret-store load under a slow Secret Service, not each signature
